description: This file defines the XmlErrorParser class used for parsing XML error responses from AWS services, including methods to parse headers and body content, and manage XML namespaces.

classes.name: XmlErrorParser
classes.description: A class that parses XML-formatted error responses from AWS services, extracting error codes, messages, and request IDs from the response.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with optional Service and XmlParser instances.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Main method that handles parsing of the response, checking status codes, and delegating to other parsing methods.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses error information from HTTP headers when the response body is empty.

methods.name: parseBody
methods.description: Parses the XML body of the response to extract error code, message, and request ID.

methods.name: registerNamespacePrefix
methods.description: Registers and manages XML namespace prefixes for XPath queries.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Extracts the error payload from the XML body, parsing detailed error structure.
